notes.title: Tokyo Underground Killer is officially out now with 10% launch discount!
notes.notes:
[p]The neon-infused first-person katana slasher [b]Tokyo Underground Killer[/b] is now available on Steam, with a [b]10% launch discount[/b] for the first week. A free demo is also live, featuring a curated selection of tutorial missions, partial main story combat stages, and key narrative segments.  

Here, you may power up by bathing in blood and enjoy the "nightlife" with your assassin's earnings![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hwP8b8hvLYU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]With the official release of [b]Tokyo Underground Killer[/b], you can now watch livestreams and videos of the game on major streaming platforms worldwide. Experience ultimate speed and thrills for yourself![/p][p][/p][p]If you've ever wanted to play a Grasshopper Manufacture-style game as a first-person shooter, be sure to give [b]Tokyo Underground Killer[/b] a try![/p][p][/p][h2]----------
Game Overview[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Tokyo Underground Killer[/b] is a 3D action game set in a neon-drenched, near-future Tokyo. You play as Kobayash, an assassin feared as the "Shinjuku Vampire," who takes on the dirty work for Japan's largest crime syndicate, Gokuraku. Using katana swordplay and your supernatural vampiric "Blood Skills," you'll hunt down and eliminate ten madmen plaguing Tokyo. The game also features a wild story with black humor and unpredictable twists, all told through comic-style illustrations.[/p][p][/p][h3]High-Speed Combat System[/h3][p][/p][p]The game features a first-person perspective as you mow down enemies based on Japanese Oni and Yōkai. The high-speed, blood-splattering action is a key feature, with light and heavy katana attacks, a quick-closing dash, and a slow-motion effect triggered by perfectly timed parries and dodges. You can even deflect enemy bullets and unleash a charged-up fiery blade attack to take down enemies from a distance. Beyond the katana, you'll find unique hidden weapons like a shuriken launcher and a cursed Japanese doll.[/p][p]As a vampire, Kobayash can regenerate health by absorbing blood from defeated enemies and unleash powerful Blood Skills, such as creating a tornado of flames. The combat system encourages constant hacking and slashing to recover health and use your Blood Skills. By collecting resources, you can unlock new abilities on the skill tree and upgrade your Blood Skills. You'll need these abilities to defeat a roster of eccentric bosses in the main missions, from a vengeful pop idol to a cult leader.[/p][p][/p][h3]"Nightlife" Between Missions[/h3][p][/p][p]Between missions, you can explore a cyberpunk Tokyo modeled after famous spots like Shinjuku and Akihabara. The city offers activities like pachinko, UFO catchers, and gachapon machines, and you can display the items you collect in your Shinjuku apartment. There are even secret areas like a "free information center." Taking a break from the underworld to enjoy Tokyo's nightlife is a great way to unwind.[/p][p][/p][h3]All-Star Production Team[/h3][p][/p][p]The game's story is told through approximately 100 pages of comic-style illustrations by comic artist Hans Steinbach. The soundtrack includes over two hours of music by composer Andrew Hulshult, known for his work on titles like [i]Dusk[/i] and the [i]Doom Eternal[/i] expansion, "The Ancient Gods." The Japanese voice cast is also top-notch, with Hidekatsu Shibata, known for his role as Monkey D. Dragon in [i]One Piece[/i], voicing Kobayash's boss, Ishihara.[/p]

notes.title: Blood and Neon-infused Katana Action from Japan!
notes.notes:
[p][b]'Tokyo Underground Killer' releases new Gameplay Overview video, set to launch on Steam September 5, 2025.[/b][/p][p]To celebrate this announcement, our team has simultaneously released a new [b]gameplay overview video[/b], giving players worldwide their first in-depth look at the fast-paced combat and protagonist Kobayashi's life in Tokyo's crime-infested underworld, where flashy neon lights and disturbing violence intertwine.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6Nkz4vwsdwE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Players take on the role of the “Shinjuku Vampire” Kobayashi, a notorious assassin working for Japan’s biggest crime syndicate Gokuraku. Experience fast-paced sword fights in seedy alleyways, use 10 supernatural Blood Skills to unleash fire tornadoes or suck out enemies' health, and employ unlockable skills to overcome the game’s 10 different, challenging bosses.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42759476/262c2ff5237280ae5269f991955f18055b4c7c30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check out the video to get a full overview of the game’s over-the-top katana violence combined with a beautiful neon Tokyo backdrop based on real locations such as Akihabara or Shinjuku.[/p][p]The game is fully voiced in English and Japanese, with a Japanese all-star cast featuring legendary voice actor Hidekatsu Shibata (Naruto, One Piece, Dragonball, etc) as Kobayashi’s dreaded boss Ishihara.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42759476/569b1baf78dcef017ee9facc500c046d590f4577.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Daniel Hedjazi (aka Bentoman), Studio Head and Director at Phoenix Game Productions, states: "Creating this game was our dream and passion for many years. We can't wait for players to finally experience our violent, fever-dreamish vision of Tokyo. Between maniac Yakuza bosses, revenge-driven Idols and enticing cult leaders, Kobayashi's trip through Tokyo’s underworld is not only a relentless fight for survival, but also a journey of self-discovery, filled with dark humor and unexpected twists.[/p][p]Paired with an unforgettable soundtrack created by legendary musician Andrew Hulshult and a story told through almost 100 pages of unique comic book panels drawn by comic artist Hans Steinbach, we believe that Tokyo Underground Killer will deliver a gaming experience unlike anything else".[/p][p]Get ready to become Kobayashi on September 5th and carve a bloody path to freedom under the bloody cover of Tokyo's neon-drenched night![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42759476/0b903ebbe225a35e2ee0a57673c7cb7a5d22bcc4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Tokyo Underground Killer - Executioner Trailer
notes.notes:
While development on Tokyo Underground Killer is currently slowly entering its busy phase, we got a new enemy showcase ready!

The Executioner is one of the most dangerous enemies you will encounter in Tokyo Underground Killer. 
Only those who master the right combination of blood skills and precise sword attacks will survive this one!

[previewyoutube=wQMNBTQ5x5U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Tokyo Underground Killer - Berserk Showcase
notes.notes:
And we're back with another enemy showcase for Tokyo Underground Killer!
Equipped with a hookshot, the Berserk Flatliner pulls his victims close and quickly finishes them off with his giant metal fist. 
Make sure to always block his attacks!

[previewyoutube=nsMNxtKQVCw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Tokyo Underground Killer - Matchlock Elite Showcase
notes.notes:
This week we prepared a fresh video of another enemy in Tokyo Underground Killer - the Matchlock Elite Flatliner.
He's equipped with 16 rockets ready to fire off at once, so make sure to quickly dodge his attacks and try to lure other targets into the inferno!

[previewyoutube=QnUNI0RqEkg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:
In this enemy showcase video, we take a look at Tokyo Underground Killer's most common enemies, the Disciple Flatliners. While relatively easy to defeat alone, their relentless hunger for blood makes them dangerous in groups. Watch out for the armored ones!
